name: simple-rpn-calculator
description: Evaluate reverse Polish notation with add and subtract.
--: - prettier and markdownlint-cli are devDependencies. yarn.lock is what local runs and CI share.
- .prettierignore lists *.md, so Prettier skips Markdown and markdownlint formats it.
- yarn lint and yarn format pass extra arguments through to Prettier and markdownlint.
- If no files were given, the prettier scripts set -- . then forward "$@".
- markdownlint-cli lints every path you hand it, so the markdown scripts keep only *.md.
- The scripts call yarn prettier and yarn markdownlint so Yarn resolves the devDependency. markdownlint-cli stays inside the Yarn cache zip, and that path is not executable on its own.

scripts.lint:prettier: sh -c 'if [ $# -eq 0 ]; then set -- .; fi; yarn prettier --check "$@"' --
scripts.lint:markdown: sh -c 'if [ $# -eq 0 ]; then yarn markdownlint "**/*.md"; else for file in "$@"; do case "$file" in *.md) yarn markdownlint "$file";; esac; done; fi' --
scripts.format:prettier: sh -c 'if [ $# -eq 0 ]; then set -- .; fi; yarn prettier --write "$@"' --
scripts.format:markdown: sh -c 'if [ $# -eq 0 ]; then yarn markdownlint --fix "**/*.md"; else for file in "$@"; do case "$file" in *.md) yarn markdownlint --fix "$file";; esac; done; fi' --
